about.title: Software, data and operational systems.
about.body: I am Chamsoudine THIENTA, also known as Shams, a Software Engineer and Data Analyst based in Bamako, Mali. My work covers web development, backend architecture, APIs and databases with Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, React/Next.js, Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Power BI. I also teach software development, databases, MERISE and computer architecture, with more than 200 students trained.
points: Building stronger skills in Data Engineering while staying grounded in software delivery and analytics.
Interested in banks, NGOs, telecommunications, mining, technology companies and international missions.
Designing solutions for unstable connections, modest devices and organizations still moving from manual processes to digital systems.

agritechmali.problem: Agricultural decisions can benefit from crop recommendations and fast plant disease identification.
